title: 2014 AMC 8 Problem 16
statement: The “Middle School Eight” basketball conference has \(8\) teams. Every season, each team plays every other conference team twice (home and away), and each team also plays \(4\) games against non-conference opponents. What is the total number of games in a season involving the “Middle School Eight” teams?

solutions.text:
Each team plays \(4\) non-conference games, for \(8\cdot4=32\) games involving Middle School Eight teams and non-conference opponents.

Within the conference, each of the \(8\) teams has \(7\) home games against the other teams, so there are \(8\cdot7=56\) conference games. The total is \(32+56=88\).

Thus, B is the correct answer.
hints: Count non-conference games separately from conference games.
For conference games, count each team’s home games against the other seven teams.
